The [[Gaki Polymock Piece]] is one of the 18 pieces that a player can pick while playing [[Polymock]].

When using this piece, you take the [[Gaki Form]].

[[Category:Polymock pieces]]

==Acquisition==
This piece drops as a reward from [[Destroyer Chest]] and [[Dragrimmar Chest]].
